meta.title: Hair's Breadth
meta.description: I shall save humanity's ambitions for the stars!

units.rawText: At the Ptolemy Data Center in the Titan Base.
units.displayText: At the Ptolemy Data Center in the Titan Base.

spans.text: At the Ptolemy Data Center in the Titan Base.

units.rawText: Xinghuan and her exo stand like a goddess of war at the main door, preventing anything from getting past her. Meanwhile, the entropics are slowly nibbling away at her operand shields.
units.displayText: Xinghuan and her exo stand like a goddess of war at the main door, preventing anything from getting past her. Meanwhile, the entropics are slowly nibbling away at her operand shields.

spans.text: Xinghuan and her exo stand like a goddess of war at the main door, preventing anything from getting past her. Meanwhile, the entropics are slowly nibbling away at her operand shields.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: Xinghuan! How's it going?
units.displayText: Xinghuan! How's it going?

spans.text: Xinghuan! How's it going?

units.rawText: Just finished uploading the Titan ice cap experiment logs.
units.displayText: Just finished uploading the Titan ice cap experiment logs.

spans.text: Just finished uploading the Titan ice cap experiment logs.

units.rawText: I'll have Liuxing deliver them to you. I'll take the last of the data on my personal terminal.
units.displayText: I'll have Liuxing deliver them to you. I'll take the last of the data on my personal terminal.

spans.text: I'll have Liuxing deliver them to you. I'll take the last of the data on my personal terminal.

units.rawText: No, you've done enough. If I'm not wrong, the information regarding the ice caps is the last item on the list of intermediate-priority data.
units.displayText: No, you've done enough. If I'm not wrong, the information regarding the ice caps is the last item on the list of intermediate-priority data.

spans.text: No, you've done enough. If I'm not wrong, the information regarding the ice caps is the last item on the list of intermediate-priority data.

units.rawText: You've done a good job. Now get out of there before the comet arrives.
units.displayText: You've done a good job. Now get out of there before the comet arrives.

spans.text: You've done a good job. Now get out of there before the comet arrives.

units.rawText: However, Xinghuan does not begin to withdraw as instructed by Yuwang. Instead, she begins firing her exo's weapons once again.
units.displayText: However, Xinghuan does not begin to withdraw as instructed by Yuwang. Instead, she begins firing her exo's weapons once again.

spans.text: However, Xinghuan does not begin to withdraw as instructed by Yuwang. Instead, she begins firing her exo's weapons once again.

units.rawText: A hail of shots fills the air and several entropics who slipped in through thin spots in the operand shield are promptly reduced to ash.
units.displayText: A hail of shots fills the air and several entropics who slipped in through thin spots in the operand shield are promptly reduced to ash.

spans.text: A hail of shots fills the air and several entropics who slipped in through thin spots in the operand shield are promptly reduced to ash.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, what are you doing? Cease downloading and withdraw now!
units.displayText: Xinghuan, what are you doing? Cease downloading and withdraw now!

spans.text: Xinghuan, what are you doing? Cease downloading and withdraw now!

units.rawText: I've already started downloading this last bit of data... If I stop it now, it'll all be corrupted!
units.displayText: I've already started downloading this last bit of data... If I stop it now, it'll all be corrupted!

spans.text: I've already started downloading this last bit of data... If I stop it now, it'll all be corrupted!

units.rawText: But this is the lowest-priority data! I told you already, you haven't been backed up yet, if you die now...
units.displayText: But this is the lowest-priority data! I told you already, you haven't been backed up yet, if you die now...

spans.text: But this is the lowest-priority data! I told you already, you haven't been backed up yet, if you die now...

units.rawText: You don't get it, Yuwang... those guys set it to the lowest priority.
units.displayText: You don't get it, Yuwang... those guys set it to the lowest priority.

spans.text: You don't get it, Yuwang... those guys set it to the lowest priority.

units.rawText: After seeing that the agents behind Yuwang are on the Millennium Pegasus, she breathes a sigh of relief.
units.displayText: After seeing that the agents behind Yuwang are on the Millennium Pegasus, she breathes a sigh of relief.

spans.text: After seeing that the agents behind Yuwang are on the Millennium Pegasus, she breathes a sigh of relief.

units.rawText: ...It's the backup data for all the agents in the Saturnian system... both the ones who just got on board the ship, and the ones who already died.
units.displayText: ...It's the backup data for all the agents in the Saturnian system... both the ones who just got on board the ship, and the ones who already died.

spans.text: ...It's the backup data for all the agents in the Saturnian system... both the ones who just got on board the ship, and the ones who already died.

units.rawText: What... did you...
units.displayText: What... did you...

spans.text: What... did you...

units.rawText: Xinghuan glances around inside the base, looking at several mini-robots that are lying on the ground. They have completely ceased functioning.
units.displayText: Xinghuan glances around inside the base, looking at several mini-robots that are lying on the ground. They have completely ceased functioning.

spans.text: Xinghuan glances around inside the base, looking at several mini-robots that are lying on the ground. They have completely ceased functioning.

units.rawText: They... They edited the data preservation priorities and assigned their own data the lowest priority. They did everything they could to protect the research data.
units.displayText: They... They edited the data preservation priorities and assigned their own data the lowest priority. They did everything they could to protect the research data.

spans.text: They... They edited the data preservation priorities and assigned their own data the lowest priority. They did everything they could to protect the research data.

units.rawText: They even... They even used their own bodies as power supply units to generate one final barrier, just to keep the data safe.
units.displayText: They even... They even used their own bodies as power supply units to generate one final barrier, just to keep the data safe.

spans.text: They even... They even used their own bodies as power supply units to generate one final barrier, just to keep the data safe.

units.rawText: Yuwang, I cannot, and I will not abandon them. So tell me what I should do now.
units.displayText: Yuwang, I cannot, and I will not abandon them. So tell me what I should do now.

spans.text: Yuwang, I cannot, and I
will not
abandon them. So tell me what I should do now.

units.rawText: ...You stupid little dorks...
units.displayText: ...You stupid little dorks...

spans.text: ...You stupid little dorks...

units.rawText: Yuwang clenches his fists.
units.displayText: Yuwang clenches his fists.

spans.text: Yuwang clenches his fists.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, if you stay there... cheh.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, if you stay there... cheh.

spans.text: Xinghuan, if you stay there... cheh.

units.rawText: However, he has no choice but to hang his head in resignation after he sees the determination burning in Xinghuan's eyes through the communication window.
units.displayText: However, he has no choice but to hang his head in resignation after he sees the determination burning in Xinghuan's eyes through the communication window.

spans.text: However, he has no choice but to hang his head in resignation after he sees the determination burning in Xinghuan's eyes through the communication window.

units.rawText: ...Cut the base's life support systems and reroute the residential sector's operand supply. Pour everything except what is needed for data transfer into the defensive barrier.
units.displayText: ...Cut the base's life support systems and reroute the residential sector's operand supply. Pour everything except what is needed for data transfer into the defensive barrier.

spans.text: ...Cut the base's life support systems and reroute the residential sector's operand supply. Pour everything except what is needed for data transfer into the defensive barrier.

units.rawText: Will do, partner.
units.displayText: Will do, partner.

spans.text: Will do, partner.

units.rawText: Transfer the base's fire control permissions to me, authentication code 528491.
units.displayText: Transfer the base's fire control permissions to me, authentication code 528491.

spans.text: Transfer the base's fire control permissions to me, authentication code 528491.

units.rawText: Huh? Wait, Yuwang...
units.displayText: Huh? Wait, Yuwang...

spans.text: Huh? Wait, Yuwang...

units.rawText: I know there's no way I'm going to change your mind when you've got that look on your face. So I'm not going to bother.
units.displayText: I know there's no way I'm going to change your mind when you've got that look on your face. So I'm not going to bother.

spans.text: I know there's no way I'm going to change your mind when you've got that look on your face. So I'm not going to bother.

units.rawText: The Millennium Pegasus will cover you and buy you time.
units.displayText: The Millennium Pegasus will cover you and buy you time.

spans.text: The Millennium Pegasus will cover you and buy you time.

units.rawText: You're going to have a hard time maneuvering, and you still need to withdraw those research agents...
units.displayText: You're going to have a hard time maneuvering, and you still need to withdraw those research agents...

spans.text: You're going to have a hard time maneuvering, and you still need to withdraw those research agents...

units.rawText: I only have trouble moving; I'm not immobile. And if we're going to take a risk, it's only natural that I should maximize our chances of success.
units.displayText: I only have trouble moving; I'm not immobile. And if we're going to take a risk, it's only natural that I should maximize our chances of success.

spans.text: I only have trouble moving; I'm not immobile. And if we're going to take a risk, it's only natural that I should maximize our chances of success.

units.rawText: Take care of the entropics that are already inside the base. I'll hold the main gate.
units.displayText: Take care of the entropics that are already inside the base. I'll hold the main gate.

spans.text: Take care of the entropics that are already inside the base. I'll hold the main gate.

units.rawText: Thanks, partner.
units.displayText: Thanks, partner.

spans.text: Thanks, partner.

units.rawText: Xinghuan raises a fist and taps it to the comms projection with a cheerful smile. Yuwang raises his own fist and lightly bumps Xinghuan's projection.
units.displayText: Xinghuan raises a fist and taps it to the comms projection with a cheerful smile. Yuwang raises his own fist and lightly bumps Xinghuan's projection.

spans.text: Xinghuan raises a fist and taps it to the comms projection with a cheerful smile. Yuwang raises his own fist and lightly bumps Xinghuan's projection.

units.rawText: Being your partner is really tiring, you know.
units.displayText: Being your partner is really tiring, you know.

spans.text: Being your partner is really tiring, you know.

units.rawText: Heh, I'll consider that high praise, then.
units.displayText: Heh, I'll consider that high praise, then.

spans.text: Heh, I'll consider that high praise, then.

units.rawText: System connection complete. Now interfacing with all weapons systems on Titan Base...
units.displayText: System connection complete. Now interfacing with all weapons systems on Titan Base...

spans.text: System connection complete. Now interfacing with all weapons systems on Titan Base...

units.rawText: Yuwang carefully scrolls through the base facilities.
units.displayText: Yuwang carefully scrolls through the base facilities.

spans.text: Yuwang carefully scrolls through the base facilities.

units.rawText: The operand barrier integrity is only 70%... But it's slowly restoring after the rest of the base's operands were rerouted into it.
units.displayText: The operand barrier integrity is only 70%... But it's slowly restoring after the rest of the base's operands were rerouted into it.

spans.text: The operand barrier integrity is only 70%... But it's slowly restoring after the rest of the base's operands were rerouted into it.

units.rawText: The life support systems are offline... As for the remaining spaceships... They're pretty much all wrecked, huh... Hm? The escape pods...
units.displayText: The life support systems are offline... As for the remaining spaceships... They're pretty much all wrecked, huh... Hm? The escape pods...

spans.text: The life support systems are offline... As for the remaining spaceships... They're pretty much all wrecked, huh... Hm? The escape pods...

units.rawText: While she did say she wouldn't be that reckless... Well, this is just in case.
units.displayText: While she did say she wouldn't be that reckless... Well, this is just in case.

spans.text: While she did say she wouldn't be that reckless... Well, this is just in case.

units.rawText: Yuwang enters a string of commands into the comms interface and then hits the send key.
units.displayText: Yuwang enters a string of commands into the comms interface and then hits the send key.

spans.text: Yuwang enters a string of commands into the comms interface and then hits the send key.

units.rawText: Don't have many point defense guns or much ammo for them... But this should be enough to buy her time.
units.displayText: Don't have many point defense guns or much ammo for them... But this should be enough to buy her time.

spans.text: Don't have many point defense guns or much ammo for them... But this should be enough to buy her time.

units.rawText: Yuwang presses several buttons and panels spring open as the gun turrets hidden in the base deploy themselves, then deliver a storm of withering fire to the entropics approaching the base.
units.displayText: Yuwang presses several buttons and panels spring open as the gun turrets hidden in the base deploy themselves, then deliver a storm of withering fire to the entropics approaching the base.

spans.text: Yuwang presses several buttons and panels spring open as the gun turrets hidden in the base deploy themselves, then deliver a storm of withering fire to the entropics approaching the base.

units.rawText: Grah—
units.displayText: Grah—

spans.text: Grah—

units.rawText: Scores of entropics drown in a sea of lead, but the rest show no signs of stopping.
units.displayText: Scores of entropics drown in a sea of lead, but the rest show no signs of stopping.

spans.text: Scores of entropics drown in a sea of lead, but the rest show no signs of stopping.

units.rawText: Tsk... these numbers exceed the amount of entropics we detected on Titan before this... wait, could it be?!
units.displayText: Tsk... these numbers exceed the amount of entropics we detected on Titan before this... wait, could it be?!

spans.text: Tsk... these numbers exceed the amount of entropics we detected on Titan before this... wait, could it be?!

units.rawText: Yuwang activates the base's extra-planetary monitoring system.
units.displayText: Yuwang activates the base's extra-planetary monitoring system.

spans.text: Yuwang activates the base's extra-planetary monitoring system.

units.rawText: Countless chunks of debris have detached themselves from the comet and are flying toward Titan.
units.displayText: Countless chunks of debris have detached themselves from the comet and are flying toward Titan.

spans.text: Countless chunks of debris have detached themselves from the comet and are flying toward Titan.

units.rawText: The entropics on the comet are already making Titan-fall; at this rate the base won't last long.
units.displayText: The entropics on the comet are already making Titan-fall; at this rate the base won't last long.

spans.text: The entropics on the comet are already making Titan-fall; at this rate the base won't last long.

units.rawText: Xinghuan! How's your progress?!
units.displayText: Xinghuan! How's your progress?!

spans.text: Xinghuan! How's your progress?!

units.rawText: Up to 73%!
units.displayText: Up to 73%!

spans.text: Up to 73%!

units.rawText: Liuxing's almost there! Pick it up!
units.displayText: Liuxing's almost there! Pick it up!

spans.text: Liuxing's almost there! Pick it up!

units.rawText: I know, I asked the other agents to lend a hand.
units.displayText: I know, I asked the other agents to lend a hand.

spans.text: I know, I asked the other agents to lend a hand.

units.rawText: You really are my partner after all; your timing is perfect.
units.displayText: You really are my partner after all; your timing is perfect.

spans.text: You really are my partner after all; your timing is perfect.

units.rawText: Tsk, more of these assholes.
units.displayText: Tsk, more of these assholes.

spans.text: Tsk, more of these assholes.

units.rawText: Yuwang frowns as he hears the gunfire over the comms.
units.displayText: Yuwang frowns as he hears the gunfire over the comms.

spans.text: Yuwang frowns as he hears the gunfire over the comms.

units.rawText: We're barely holding on right now... But at this rate... Maybe I should start up the escape pod first.
units.displayText: We're barely holding on right now... But at this rate... Maybe I should start up the escape pod first.

spans.text: We're barely holding on right now... But at this rate... Maybe I should start up the escape pod first.

units.rawText: KABOOM!
units.displayText: KABOOM!

spans.text: KABOOM!

units.rawText: A massive explosion shakes the base, and a series of shrill, urgent alarms fill the air in response.
units.displayText: A massive explosion shakes the base, and a series of shrill, urgent alarms fill the air in response.

spans.text: A massive explosion shakes the base, and a series of shrill, urgent alarms fill the air in response.

units.rawText: (Wailing of klaxons)
units.displayText: (Wailing of klaxons)

spans.text: (Wailing of klaxons)

units.rawText: Whoa... What just happened?!
units.displayText: Whoa... What just happened?!

spans.text: Whoa... What just happened?!

units.rawText: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 56%.
units.displayText: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 56%.

spans.text: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 56%.

units.rawText: Since when did ordinary entropics have weapons this powerful? Could it be...
units.displayText: Since when did ordinary entropics have weapons this powerful? Could it be...

spans.text: Since when did ordinary entropics have weapons this powerful? Could it be...

units.rawText: On the viewscreen, the sinister comet has already entered orbit around Titan. Yuwang turns up the magnification to maximum and he can make out a person standing on the purple comet.
units.displayText: On the viewscreen, the sinister comet has already entered orbit around Titan. Yuwang turns up the magnification to maximum and he can make out a person standing on the purple comet.

spans.text: On the viewscreen, the sinister comet has already entered orbit around Titan. Yuwang turns up the magnification to maximum and he can make out a person standing on the purple comet.

units.rawText: Is this what that High Order Entropic really looks like... Wait, what's she trying to do?!
units.displayText: Is this what that High Order Entropic really looks like... Wait, what's she trying to do?!

spans.text: Is this what that High Order Entropic really looks like... Wait, what's she trying to do?!

units.rawText: The High Order Entropic's body flashes, and right after that, several purple chunks of cometary debris rain down on Titan.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropic's body flashes, and right after that, several purple chunks of cometary debris rain down on Titan.

spans.text: The High Order Entropic's body flashes, and right after that, several purple chunks of cometary debris rain down on Titan.

units.rawText: Meteors... Are they...
units.displayText: Meteors... Are they...

spans.text: Meteors... Are they...

units.rawText: Operand barrier to max power now! All point defense guns, target and destroy those meteors!
units.displayText: Operand barrier to max power now! All point defense guns, target and destroy those meteors!

spans.text: Operand barrier to max power now! All point defense guns, target and destroy those meteors!

units.rawText: <size=40>KABOOM!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!

spans.text: KABOOM!

units.rawText: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 25%...
units.displayText: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 25%...

spans.text: Defensive barrier under attack by high-energy weaponry. Barrier integrity at 25%...

units.rawText: Even the combined fire of the point defense guns can't stop the meteors' fall. The operand barrier's light dims under the consecutive impacts.
units.displayText: Even the combined fire of the point defense guns can't stop the meteors' fall. The operand barrier's light dims under the consecutive impacts.

spans.text: Even the combined fire of the point defense guns can't stop the meteors' fall. The operand barrier's light dims under the consecutive impacts.

units.rawText: Yet, the most terrifying part of the assault is not the meteors, but the hunters hidden among them.
units.displayText: Yet, the most terrifying part of the assault is not the meteors, but the hunters hidden among them.

spans.text: Yet, the most terrifying part of the assault is not the meteors, but the hunters hidden among them.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!
units.displayText: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!

spans.text: Millennium Pegasus, prepare for launch... All agents, prepare to withdraw now! Xinghuan and I will catch up with you!
